eventDetail.scope: Beyond Generative AI: Engineering Intelligent, Trustworthy, Autonomous, and Responsible Computing Systems.  Artificial Intelligence is rapidly advancing beyond generative models toward intelligent, autonomous, trustworthy, and human-centric computing systems integrated with modern digital infrastructures. The conference provides an international forum for researchers, academicians, industry practitioners, and policymakers to present cutting-edge research in next-generation information technologies. Topics include foundation AI, machine learning, data science, cloud-edge computing, cyber-physical systems, intelligent networking, cybersecurity, quantum computing, human-centered computing, and interdisciplinary AI applications. Emphasis is placed on scalable, secure, trustworthy, explainable, privacy-preserving, and sustainable computing solutions addressing real-world scientific, industrial, and societal challenges.
